description: Find every domain currently pointing at a given IP address, with first-/last-seen dates per domain. Use this when investigating shared hosting, malicious infrastructure pivots, or to enumerate co-tenants of a flagged IP. Do NOT use this to resolve a domain's IP (use `dns_lookup`) or to search DNS records by pattern (use `reverse_dns`).

from_needle.description: Pagination needle from previous response. Max 300 records per page.

include_additional_checks.description: If true, performs additional DNS checks (wildcard, domain activeness). Slower but more detailed.

preview.description: If true, returns just the domain names without additional information.

name: reverse_ip
